qualifier: Hartnup and dicarboxylic aminoaciduria transporter variants
name: Plasma membrane amino acid transport and inherited aminoacidurias
rationale: All members concern amino acid uptake across the plasma membrane by SLC carriers and their disease variants; unlike the confusables it lacks peptide transport and iminoglycinuria and carries the SLC1A1 and SLC6A14 variants plus Hartnup tryptophan transport.

qualifier: transcriptional restraint and progenitor proliferation
name: Transcriptional restraint of myeloid progenitor differentiation
rationale: Members describe transcriptional programmes (RUNX1, VENTX, promyelocyte, granulopoiesis) and negative regulation of monocyte, macrophage and granulocyte differentiation in myeloid progenitors, whereas confusables carry positive differentiation, G-CSF and chemokine-receptor monocyte modules.

qualifier: AXIN stability in the destruction complex
name: Canonical Wnt signaling via AXIN destruction-complex stability
rationale: All members are canonical Wnt/beta-catenin events centred on the AXIN/APC destruction complex; AXIN degradation and XAV939 stabilization of AXIN set it apart from confusables focused on target-gene repression and DVL activation.

qualifier: cAMP synthesis and PKA activation
name: cAMP synthesis and protein kinase A activation
rationale: Members cover GPCR-coupled cAMP production, forskolin response and PKA activation; unlike confusables it lacks CREB phosphorylation, calcium-stimulated cyclases and inhibitory adenylate cyclase signaling.

core: Vitamin K and vitamin C metabolism
qualifier: gamma-carboxylation of protein precursors
name: Vitamin K gamma-carboxylation and ascorbate metabolism
rationale: Most members concern vitamin K metabolism with gamma-carboxylation of coagulation-factor precursors and vitamin C (ascorbate) metabolism and transport, distinguishing it from vitamin D, vitamin E/ubiquinol and oxygen-transport confusables.

core: G protein regulation of adenylate cyclase
qualifier: inhibitory alpha-2 adrenergic and Gz coupling
name: Alpha-2 adrenergic and Gz inhibition of adenylate cyclase
rationale: Members describe GPCR control of adenylate cyclase dominated by inhibitory alpha-2 adrenergic and G alpha z signaling, unlike confusables centred on PKA activation, catecholamine secretion or muscarinic/purinergic inhibitory receptors.

qualifier: RUNX2 and Wnt control, mechanical load
name: RUNX2 and Wnt control of osteoblast differentiation
rationale: Members regulate osteoblast and mesenchymal stem cell proliferation and differentiation via RUNX2, Wnt antagonists, BMP and osteocyte mechanosensing, whereas confusables emphasise mineralization/collagen, chondrocytes or osteoclasts.

qualifier: tyrosine catabolism plus proline and glycine
name: Tyrosine, proline and glycine amino acid metabolism
rationale: All members are amino acid metabolic processes; tyrosine/phenylalanine catabolism separates it from organic-acid and threonine confusables, and proline, glycine and glyoxylate metabolism separates it from the phenylketonuria confusable.

qualifier: oocyte maturation and corpus luteum turnover
name: Ovarian follicle cycle with oocyte maturation and luteolysis
rationale: Members span follicle growth, ovulation, oocyte maturation, luteinization, luteolysis and the estrous cycle, whereas confusables are defined by gonadotropin hormone responses and secretion or Sertoli cells.

qualifier: linkage-specific ubiquitination and deubiquitinase families
name: Ubiquitin chain assembly, deubiquitination and proteasome function
rationale: Members cover linkage-specific ubiquitin chain formation, deubiquitinase families, E1/E2 activation and proteasome assembly, unlike confusables centred on misfolded-protein quality control, autophagy or neddylation.

qualifier: calcium pump and ryanodine receptor regulation
name: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium pump and release channel regulation
rationale: Members regulate SR/ER calcium uptake ATPase activity, ryanodine receptor release and cytosolic calcium clearance (including caffeine response), distinguishing it from confusables focused on stimulating calcium release or cardiac contraction and heart rate.

core: Endocytic recycling to the plasma membrane
qualifier: Golgi export and vesicular cholesterol transport
name: Endocytic recycling with Golgi export and vesicular cholesterol transport
rationale: Members concern plasma membrane-endosome trafficking and receptor recycling plus Golgi-to-plasma-membrane delivery; Golgi vesicle traffic and cholesterol transport separate it from retrograde, tubulation and constitutive-secretion confusables.

qualifier: fibronectin matrix and focal adhesion assembly
name: Fibroblast focal adhesion and fibronectin matrix assembly
rationale: Members involve integrin production, focal adhesion assembly, fibronectin matrix formation and fibroblast migration with SRF/TGF-beta matrix modules, unlike confusables centred on syndecans, stress fibres or EMT mechanosignaling.

qualifier: VEGF/Tie angiogenesis plus smooth muscle phenotypic switching
name: VEGF/Tie angiogenesis and vascular smooth muscle phenotypic switching
rationale: Members cover VEGF, neuropilin and Tie2 driven sprouting angiogenesis and lymphangiogenesis together with vascular smooth muscle proliferation, migration and phenotypic switching, which confusables lack (smooth muscle) or lack the angiogenic arm.

qualifier: atrophy, inactivity and inhibited myogenic differentiation
name: Skeletal muscle atrophy and restraint of myoblast differentiation
rationale: Members describe negative regulation of myoblast and myotube differentiation, satellite cell maintenance, inactivity-induced atrophy and SCF-proteasome control, unlike confusables about pro-myogenic differentiation, hypertrophy or contraction.

qualifier: BCR alongside TCR, with costimulatory and inhibitory co-receptors
name: TCR and BCR signaling with costimulatory and inhibitory co-receptors
rationale: Members cover TCR and BCR proximal signaling tuned by CD28, CTLA4, BTLA, CD22 and PECAM1; the B cell receptor arm distinguishes it from T cell-only confusables.

qualifier: limb and digit morphogenesis
name: Embryonic craniofacial and limb morphogenesis
rationale: Members are embryonic face, palate, nose, skull and limb/digit morphogenesis with mesenchymal development, unlike confusables that add pharyngeal-derived organs or ossification.

qualifier: soluble agonist receptors (ADP, thrombin, thromboxane, prostacyclin)
name: Agonist receptor-driven platelet activation and aggregation
rationale: Members describe platelet activation, degranulation and aggregation driven by ADP, thrombin, thromboxane and prostacyclin receptors plus GPVI, unlike confusables centred on GP1b-IX-V/collagen adhesion or integrin-Rap1 signaling.

qualifier: sarcoplasmic reticulum release in cardiac contraction and relaxation
name: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium release in cardiac contraction and relaxation
rationale: Members regulate release and clearance of sequestered calcium and its control of cardiac contraction, relaxation and heart rate, unlike confusables centred on SR calcium pump activity or positive inotropy.

qualifier: constitutive secretion and Golgi membrane targeting
name: Endocytic recycling and constitutive secretion to plasma membrane
rationale: Members cover endosome-plasma membrane recycling and constitutive secretion with protein targeting to Golgi membranes, unlike confusables centred on retrograde endosome-Golgi, lysosomal sorting or Rab/ARF regulation.

core: Cytoplasmic mRNA stability and translation control
qualifier: stress granules and stabilizing RNA-binding proteins
name: mRNA stabilization and stress-granule translational control
rationale: Members concern 3'-UTR binding proteins (HuR, AUF1, IGF2BPs), translational silencing and stress granule/PKR responses, unlike confusables dominated by TTP/KSRP-mediated decay, decapping and processing.

qualifier: MITF-M targets and light response
name: MITF-M melanocyte pigmentation and light response
rationale: Members describe MITF-M target genes, melanin biosynthesis, pigment granule localization, melanocyte proliferation/differentiation and UV/blue-light responses, unlike confusables centred on MITF-M cell-cycle/DNA repair or melanosome assembly.

qualifier: amino acids, oligopeptides and urate
name: Solute carrier transport of amino acids, peptides and urate
rationale: Members are SLC-mediated transport of neutral/anionic amino acids, oligopeptides, urate and organic anions with inherited defects, unlike confusables centred on organic cations, cationic amino acids or hexose absorption.

qualifier: cation-chloride cotransporters and osmotic stress responses
name: Cation-chloride cotransport and cellular osmotic stress response
rationale: Members cover renal/epithelial sodium, potassium and chloride transport (NKCC/NCC/KCC defects, SLC26A3) and hyper/hypo-osmotic responses, unlike confusables centred on Na/H exchange, tight junctions, K2P channels or P-type ATPases.

qualifier: commitment through terminal red cell maturation
name: Erythroid lineage commitment through terminal red cell maturation
rationale: Most members describe erythroid commitment (TAL1-GFI1B) and terminal red cell membrane maturation, unlike confusables centred on megakaryocytes or haematopoietic stem cells; one TAK1/ATF module is an outlier.

qualifier: retinoic acid biosynthesis
name: Vitamin A metabolism and retinoic acid biosynthesis
rationale: Members cover retinol, retinal and retinoic acid metabolism and retinoid disease events, unlike confusables centred on the visual retinoid cycle, vitamin D or cellular retinoic acid responses.

qualifier: nephron morphogenesis and tubule segmentation
name: Embryonic kidney nephron morphogenesis and tubule segmentation
rationale: Members span intermediate mesoderm, nephric duct and metanephric nephron formation through comma/S-shaped bodies to tubule segments, whereas confusables emphasise ureteric bud formation, organ induction and kidney size.

core: Noncoding RNA modification and ribonucleoprotein assembly
qualifier: methylation and snRNP/snoRNP biogenesis
name: Noncoding RNA methylation and snRNP/snoRNP biogenesis
rationale: Members are rRNA, tRNA and snRNA methylation plus snRNP/snoRNP assembly and localization, unlike confusables centred on pseudouridylation, Cajal body protein targeting or diphthamide.

qualifier: suppression of recombination and end joining
name: Telomere capping and protection from recombination and end joining
rationale: Members concern telomere capping, packaging and protection from recombination and NHEJ with telomerase restraint, unlike confusables centred on telomere replication, t-circles/D-loops or telomerase recruitment.

qualifier: cancer receptor/SMAD mutants and RUNX3 targets
name: TGF-beta superfamily SMAD signaling with cancer mutants and RUNX3
rationale: Members cover TGF-beta, BMP, activin and AMH receptor-SMAD signaling, TGFBR3, cancer-associated receptor/SMAD mutants and RUNX3 transcriptional targets, which confusables lack.
